name: gemini-cli-agent
description: Run Google's Gemini CLI as an agent (acp:gemini-cli) over ACP. Gemini enters ACP mode via its own `--experimental-acp` flag — no adapter package — and self-authenticates with your `gemini` login (Google OAuth) or a GEMINI_API_KEY in the environment; PersonalClaw stores no key. The provider activates only when the `gemini` binary is present, and is unavailable otherwise.
author: PersonalClaw

x-meta.label: Default Model
x-meta.help: Optional model the agent defaults to. Empty uses the Gemini CLI's own default.

x-meta.label: CLI Path
x-meta.help: Optional absolute path to the gemini binary. Empty auto-resolves via PATH. Equivalent to the GEMINI_CLI_EXECUTABLE env var.
